visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a yellow knitted beanie with a Minion design and a white quilted jacket, speaks directly to the camera in a close-up shot. Behind her is a dark lake reflecting distant lights and the silhouettes of large mountains under a dim, twilight sky. (2) A transition occurs with swirling blue and white circular bokeh graphics as the camera pans slightly to the left, revealing more of the waterfront town's warm golden lights. (3) The scene cuts to a vertical shot of a tall, grey stone church tower with a clock and a pointed steeple, set against a backdrop of steep mountains. A split-screen overlay at the top displays a digital illustration of a snowy castle from an animated film. (4) The camera shows a low-angle view of a town square with colorful pastel buildings (mint green, yellow, pink) and a large Christmas tree; a hand enters the frame pointing towards the architecture. An overlay of animated characters in a reindeer-drawn sleigh appears briefly. (5) The shot returns to the woman in the Minion beanie, who smiles and points over her shoulder towards the scenic background. (6) A slow panning shot captures the iconic view of Hallstatt at dusk, featuring the church spire, the dark reflective lake, a small boat creating a wake, and mist-covered mountains. A social media handle and avatar appear as an overlay at the end.
